data.one_liner: Renders a progress dialog with multiple types of customizable loading indicators.
data.what_it_does: The package allows developers to easily show and hide a progress dialog window containing different types of built-in loading indicators and custom messages. It supports customization of dimensions, appearance, text styles, and orientation.
use_when: You need to display a loading progress dialog with a message during asynchronous operations.
You want a choice of multiple predefined loading indicator animations.
avoid_when: You prefer inline loading indicators rather than dialog overlays.
You use a reactive/state-driven UI approach where dialogs are managed via app state instead of imperative show/hide calls.
strengths: Provides multiple indicator types out of the box (normal, threeline, multiline, refresh, hurricane, phoenix, iphone).
Supports custom widgets for loading indicators.
Allows updating the message dynamically while the dialog is open.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative show and hide methods rather than declarative widget states.
